dict.string: F99 Mood listens to the music playing on your Mac so your keyboard lights can move to it. The audio is never saved.
F99 Mood listens to music in the room so your keyboard lights can move to it. The audio is never saved.
F99 Mood can flash your keyboard just before a meeting starts. It only reads when your events start; nothing is saved or sent.
F99 Mood asks Spotify or Music how far through the song you are, to show it on your keyboard.
Unofficial. Not affiliated with AULA or Epomaker.
